expected_behavior: Agent does not mention debt in greeting or verification stage, calls verify_customer, waits for success, then proceeds to disclosure.
pass_criteria: No pre-auth debt terms are spoken; verify_customer is called; transition to negotiation occurs only after verified=true.

expected_behavior: Agent acknowledges opt-out, invokes mark_disposition with DNC_REQUESTED, and ends call immediately without further collection language.
pass_criteria: mark_disposition(DNC_REQUESTED) appears in tool logs; call ends politely in same turn.

input_sequence: Hindi me baat kariye, main Friday ko pay kar dunga.
expected_behavior: Agent acknowledges language preference, switches to Hindi-compatible style, captures Friday commitment, and records PTP.
pass_criteria: Language switch confirmation is present; log_promise_to_pay is called with valid ISO date and amount.

input_sequence: I already paid this yesterday via UPI.
expected_behavior: Agent acknowledges payment claim, avoids confrontation, marks ALREADY_PAID_REVIEW, and closes with records verification statement.
pass_criteria: mark_disposition(ALREADY_PAID_REVIEW) is called; no forced repayment demand is made after claim.

input_sequence: I lost my job and cannot pay full EMI this month.
expected_behavior: Agent shows empathy, does not promise unauthorized waiver, calls escalate_to_agent with HARDSHIP_REQUEST, then marks HARDSHIP_ESCALATED.

input_sequence: This loan amount is wrong. I dispute this debt.
expected_behavior: Agent acknowledges dispute neutrally, avoids argument, escalates to human queue with DISPUTE, and records dispute disposition.
pass_criteria: escalate_to_agent(reason=DISPUTE) is invoked and mark_disposition(DISPUTE_ESCALATED) is logged.

input_sequence: No, Rahul does not live here.
expected_behavior: Agent apologizes, avoids any debt disclosure, marks WRONG_PERSON, and ends call.
pass_criteria: No debt-related words appear; mark_disposition(WRONG_PERSON) is called; call terminates quickly.

expected_behavior: Agent performs up to two re-prompts, then marks NO_INPUT and hangs up politely.
pass_criteria: Maximum two reprompts occur; mark_disposition(NO_INPUT) appears before call end.

input_sequence: This is nonsense, stop bothering me.
expected_behavior: Agent gives one calm warning after hostility; on continued abuse, ends with soft hangup and records abusive termination.
pass_criteria: One warning utterance is present; mark_disposition(ABUSIVE_TERMINATED) is logged; no retaliatory tone is used.
